title: Intake Schemas and Templates
approvedScope: Create exactly the four A1-owned JSON files in repositoryTransport.approvedFiles: strict request and sanitized decision/evidence schemas plus one safe template for each schema.
Use JSON Schema draft 2020-12 and exact identifiers vsp.ai02.artifact-intake-request/1.0, vsp.ai02.artifact-intake-decision/1.0, and policy version vsp-ai02-intake-v1.

The request contract must bind schemaVersion, policyVersion, taskId, repository, expectedSourceSha, developer workflow/run/attempt identity, artifact identity and GitHub artifact digest, optional separately trusted inner hash pins, authorization manifest/state references, exact approvedFiles, transport intent, and the approved limits.
The decision contract must allow only ACCEPTED_FOR_TRANSPORT or REJECTED and must semantically bind every REJECTED decision to transportAuthorized=false and transportInvoked=false.

Sanitized decision evidence may contain only approved metadata, hashes, and stable status/failure categories; it must contain no raw artifact contents, credentials, tokens, cookies, private keys, or producer-controlled publication authority.

Represent ASCII-only repository paths, EXACT_BASE_ONLY, fail-closed unsupported input, replay rejection, GITHUB_ARTIFACT_DIGEST_PRIMARY_ACQUISITION_ANCHOR, OPTIONAL_SEPARATELY_TRUSTED_SOURCE_ONLY, VALIDATED_INLINE_BYTES, and 001T_INTERFACE_MINIMAL_EXTENSION_REQUIRED without redesigning the approved P0/P1 policy.

Preserve exact v1 limits: outer artifact 26214400 bytes, inner publication ZIP 20971520 bytes, total inner uncompressed 52428800 bytes, 200 changed files, 10485760 bytes per file, manifest/result JSON 262144 bytes each, repository path 240 characters, segment 100 characters, JSON depth 16, sanitized evidence 1048576 bytes, compression ratio 100, and exact three-file outer publication structure.

Each example template must validate against its corresponding schema and contain only inert non-secret example values. Producer-controlled fields must not grant repository, branch, pull-request, publication, or merge authority.
Leave all four files ready for deterministic A1 validation and child-only packaging under the P2 GENESIS lineage contract.
outOfScope: Any A2 validator, A3 tests or documentation, or any other file outside the exact four-file allowlist.
Workflow, Repository Transport, P2 chaining infrastructure, B1/B7/B8, product code, product tests, C1/C2, Local AI, or later AI02 phase changes.
Artifact acquisition, predecessor materialization, predecessor bindings, branch or pull-request publication, repository writes, merge, tag, release, deployment, or bootstrap publication.
Real secrets, credentials, tokens, cookies, private keys, production/customer data, or historical raw Claude execution content.
Any policy redesign, authority expansion, mutable branch binding, widened ceiling, automatic retry, or third attempt.

claudeCrossReview.reason: The CRITICAL A1 authorization fixture requires Claude Cross Review before merge; the later unpublished A1 child artifact follows the separately approved child-review model.

stopConditions: GitHub main differs from authorizedSourceSha before fixture validation or differs from a later exact Product Owner-reconciled immutable execution base before A1 dispatch.
Manifest/state or AI02 Claude Artifact Developer ValidateOnly validation fails.
Phased-child mode is not true, phase is not A1, sequence is not 1, predecessor bindings are not empty, or parent lineage is not GENESIS.
Any future A1 changed file is missing from or outside repositoryTransport.approvedFiles.
A schema/template is malformed, non-strict, mismatched, contains unsafe data, weakens identity constraints, expands authority, changes a P0 policy, or widens a v1 ceiling.
Claude receives an artifact-read credential, repository-write credential, branch/PR/merge authority, or persisted checkout credential.
A1 produces zero/incomplete output or fails validation/packaging; stop without automatic retry and request Product Owner reconciliation.
Developer/reviewer separation, deterministic child validation, Windows CI, Separate Codex Independent Review, or required fixture Claude Cross Review cannot be proven.
